description: Four hours of a fictional Monday (2026-10-19, 09:00-13:20 UTC), one cycle every 5 minutes. Stale feed backlog, a single-source rumor (Kryvex), a prompt-injection and a homoglyph headline, a Reuters story copied by two sites (Meridex hot wallet), independent confirmation 20 minutes later while BTC and ETH fall on volume, a later same-headline copy, an official SEC action corroborated in the next cycle, and four Phase 6a candidate entries: one before the shadow started, one allowed while a REDUCE event is live, one already blocked by the confidence floor, one allowed while a BLOCK event is live. All names are invented; nothing here reports a real event.
